title: Server upsert can overwrite unsynced local feed edits

evidence.quote:
existingFeed.name = feed.name
                existingFeed.mode = feed.mode
                existingFeed.maxArticles = feed.maxArticles
                existingFeed.isEnabled = feed.isEnabled
                existingFeed.serverUpdatedAt = feed.serverUpdatedAt
                existingFeed.locallyModified = feed.locallyModified

reasoning: The domain model explicitly tracks locallyModified to mean a feed has unsynced local changes, but upsertAll blindly replaces the editable fields and the dirty flag from the incoming Feed. If a stale server feed is applied for the same URL with locallyModified false, the local name/mode/maxArticles/isEnabled changes are overwritten and the dirty marker is cleared, so the local edit can no longer be discovered by getLocallyModifiedFeeds(). The confidence is medium because the larger sync flow may usually push first, but the repository contract itself has no guard or conflict policy.
reproduction: Persist a Feed with url X, name `Local`, mode `.briefing`, locallyModified true. Call upsertAll with a Feed for url X from the server with name `Remote`, mode `.fidelity`, locallyModified false. The stored feed becomes `Remote`/`.fidelity` and locallyModified false.
recommendation: Define the conflict policy in FeedRepositoryProtocol and enforce it in upsertAll. At minimum, preserve local editable fields and locallyModified when existingFeed.locallyModified is true unless the incoming serverUpdatedAt is known to supersede the local change; only clear locallyModified after a confirmed push/merge acknowledgement.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The linked Domain tests only verify Feed defaults and enum values. They do not cover FeedRepository.upsertAll, serverUpdatedAt conflict behavior, or preservation of locallyModified feeds.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a FeedRepository test that seeds a locallyModified feed, upserts a server feed with the same URL, and asserts that local editable fields and locallyModified remain intact until the sync layer explicitly clears the flag.
minimumFixScope: FeedRepository.upsertAll conflict handling, FeedRepositoryProtocol documentation, and repository-level sync tests.
